subject: MAP addendum — acceptance schedule and obligations
messages:
From: Maya R. Singh <maya.singh@bluepointhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed change to MAP: acceptance window and evaluation deliverables

Hi Rafael / Priyom,

Thanks for the call this morning. After syncing with clinical ops and procurement, we need to shift our internal acceptance window by one week to accommodate an extra integration test run. That impacts our originally targeted close date (from 2028-07-10 to 2028-07-17).

Key asks for your MAP addendum:
- Confirm new acceptance window: 2028-07-10 — 2028-07-17 (final acceptance by 07/17)
- Confirm a single-week extension for the PO issuance and an updated delivery checklist for the integration tests
- Provide updated technical evaluation workbook (we attached our internal test cases)

I've attached an updated-technical-eval.xlsx with our revised test matrix. Procurement will need a clear list of deliverables tied to milestone acceptance to process the PO.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate the one-week extension without changing the commercial terms? If a short credit is required to keep our CSAT targets on track, let us know what that would look like.

Thanks,
Maya

Maya R. Singh
Director, Clinical Integrations
Bluepoint Health

Attachment: updated-technical-eval.xlsx (Excel workbook, 12 KB)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Maya R. Singh <maya.singh@bluepointhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed change to MAP: acceptance window and evaluation deliverables

Maya — thanks for the note and for the workbook. We can accommodate the extra integration run but want to make the MAP amendment explicit so there isn't ambiguity about acceptance gates.

Proposed next steps from Redwood: 
1) We'll draft a MAP addendum that updates the acceptance window to end on 2028-07-17 and enumerates the integration-test checklist items that correspond to acceptance criteria.
2) Priyom and I will schedule a 30-minute alignment call with your clinical ops and procurement tomorrow to confirm PO timing and any contract amendment needs.
3) If a temporary credit is requested, I'll scope the credit with revenue/finance and surface it as an executive-approved one-week SLA credit if needed.

Can you confirm availability for a 10 AM PT slot tomorrow (June 30)? CCing Priyom to pick up the calendar invite and draft the MAP addendum.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP addendum draft + owners for evaluation

Thanks, Maya — available at 10 AM PT tomorrow. Rafael, I'll send the calendar invite.

I've attached a short MAP-amendment-draft.pdf that: 
- updates the acceptance window to 2028-07-10 — 2028-07-17,
- lists the integration-test checklist items (aligned to Maya's workbook), and
- calls out responsibilities for test execution and sign-off (Bluepoint clinical ops = test owner; Redwood CS = facilitator).

Laura, looping you in to make sure CS is ready to run the extra test runs on 7/11 and 7/14 if needed and to confirm acceptance sign-off process.

If procurement needs language for the PO (milestone-based acceptance + invoice schedule), happy to provide a one-paragraph clause.

Attachment: MAP-amendment-draft.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Maya R. Singh <maya.singh@bluepointhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP addendum draft + owners for evaluation

Thanks, Priyom — the draft looks good. Two clarifications from procurement and ops: 

1) Procurement note: PO issuance may be impacted by our internal board review; they requested the final MAP and milestone language by 07/05 to keep the PO on the 07/12 approval calendar.
2) Ops note: Test windows look fine, but we need a single-point contact at Redwood for run coordination and a short daily sync (10 minutes) on test days (7/11, 7/14).

Procurement contact: procurement@bluepointhealth.com (external).

If we receive the final MAP by EOD 07/05 with milestone language that ties acceptance to specific test artifacts, procurement will try to keep the PO on track for 07/12. Otherwise, the PO may slip another week.

—Maya

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation note — PO timing risk and credit ask for Bluepoint (BP-4821)

Laura / Priyom — quick escalation summary and ask. Bluepoint has signaled that the MAP addendum needs to land by 07/05 to keep their PO path on 07/12. If the MAP is not finalized by EOD 07/05, procurement indicated PO will likely move to the following week and the overall close to ~07/24.

Risk summary:
- Primary risk: MAP finalization timeline vs Bluepoint board review (external)
- Impact: Close date slip of ~1 week to 07/24; potential downstream delay to integration cutover
- Commercial: customer asked whether Redwood can accommodate the one-week extension on acceptance without a commercial penalty; they also asked whether a small credit could be provided to cover internal resource costs on their side.

Ask to leadership/finance: 
- Approval to offer a one-week SLA credit (up to 7% of first-year subscription) contingent on MAP amendment signed by 07/05; finance to confirm exact figure by EOD 07/02.
- Permission to publish a one-paragraph milestone clause for procurement that ties invoice dates to acceptance artifacts.

I'll coordinate with finance and legal once I have approval; want to get an exec sign-off quickly to avoid slipping the PO.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Hi Maya / Procurement team — thanks for the patience. Attached is the final-MAP-20280703.pdf which: 
- Updates the acceptance window to 2028-07-10 — 2028-07-17,
- Lists the integration-test artifacts required for acceptance, and
- Includes the milestone invoice language procurement asked for.

We can accommodate the extra integration run and will provide a single-point contact (Priyom) for test-day coordination. Redwood agrees to the one-week SLA credit as a commercial accommodation; finance will issue the exact credit percentage on sign-off, contingent on the MAP being signed by EOD 07/05.

Next actions: 
- Maya / Procurement to confirm acceptance of the MAP addendum and provide PO timeline by 07/05.
- Bluepoint clinical ops to confirm owners for test runs on 7/11 and 7/14.
- Redwood to prepare DocuSign link for the MAP addendum (attached link) and list of artifacts to deliver on test completion.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/12345/view
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/4821
